$ jet completions bash
[exit: 0]
--- stdout ---
# jet bash completion (generated by `jet completions bash`)
# Source from your bashrc:  source <(jet completions bash)
_jet() {
    local cur prev words cword
    _init_completion 2>/dev/null || { cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"; prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"; }
    local subcommands="check build run test new dev fmt fix bind lsp explain doctor completions man version help upgrade add remove fetch update store gc install"
    local globalflags="--color --json --version --small --emit-rust --annotated --check --write --apply --pkg --out --bench --fix --online --network --plain --path --git --tag --branch --rev --locked"
    local filecmds="check build run test fmt fix bind"
    # The subcommand is the first non-flag word after `jet`.
    local sub=""
    local i
    for ((i=1; i < COMP_CWORD; i++)); do
        case "${COMP_WORDS[i]}" in
            --*) ;;
            *) sub="${COMP_WORDS[i]}"; break ;;
        esac
    done
    if [[ "$cur" == --* ]]; then
        COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$globalflags" -- "$cur") )
        return 0
    fi
    if [[ -z "$sub" ]]; then
        COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$subcommands" -- "$cur") )
        return 0
    fi
    case " $filecmds " in
        *" $sub "*) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -f -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
    esac
    COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$globalflags" -- "$cur") )
    return 0
}
complete -F _jet jet
--- stderr ---
